blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The National Capital Region Police Office (NCRPO) on Tuesday has directed all five police districts in Metro Manila to assist commuters and motorists. This is in view of the effects of the upcoming 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit and related meetings on the traffic of vehicles in the National Capital Region. Delegates from the 11 member states, as well as dialogue partners China, South Korea, Japan, the United States, Australia, New Zealand, India and Canada, will gather for the regional high-stakes meeting in Metro Manila from Nov. 15 to 17.
